entries.reason: Remote code execution through AVIF image optimization needs Astro's image service to process an untrusted AVIF. Twilda does not use astro:assets, <Image>, or an image endpoint, and the build never optimizes images. Fixed in Astro 7.2.8, a major upgrade that changes the @twilda/astro peer range; tracked as an owner decision.

Host header SSRF in the prerendered error-page fetch applies to server-rendered deployments and astro dev. Twilda is output static with no adapter (a repository rule) and ships only dist/ behind Firebase Hosting. Fixed in Astro 6.4.6 and later.

Reflected XSS through an unescaped slot name needs a slot name taken from a request. Slot names here are written in .astro source, and untrusted content reaches pages only through renderDocument output, which is escaped and tested in tests/security/xss.test.ts. Fixed in Astro 6.3.3 and later.

sharp is present only as Astro's optional image-service dependency. Twilda does not use astro:assets, <Image>, or an image endpoint, so nothing calls sharp and no uploaded or committed image is processed by it. Media is served as committed after the media guard checks it. The fix ships with Astro 7, a major upgrade of the @twilda/astro peer range.

Memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections. Hostile files are bounded before zod sees them: assertJsonBounds caps depth at 24, nodes at 50,000, and list length at 2,000, and file size is capped at 8 MB (tests/security/oversize.test.ts). Fixed in zod 4.6.6, a breaking change for @twilda/core and its published API; tracked as an owner decision.
